description: Environment identification for the Console migrate-safe runner. Identification relies on the database_id stored inside the database (sobae_meta.database_state), not on host names. project_ref is an extra check that can only add refusals. refuse_database_ids lists databases this tool must never touch (production). No connection strings or passwords belong here. The test-onboarding profile has no database_id (the branch's sobae_meta.database_state is empty): it is identified by project_ref and only accepts a database that has no registered database_id.
